[[Mragga]] is a powerful demon who feeds upon the power of others. Years ago it consumed [[Agostin]], a fabled [[warrior]] of [[Ascalon's Chosen]], and cast a spell upon his daughter [[Vanyi]], forcing her to scout out and deliver potential victims into the demon's ambushes. Mragga gains its strength from those it absorbs, so it prefers preying upon powerful heroes to increase its own power. To do this, Mragga assumes the guise of [[Sanyi]], claiming to be Vanyi's sister, and leads unsuspecting heroes into remote locations before transforming back into its original form and devouring them.
